newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Antwerp air cargo down 17.55pct in December '96.
newsitem.headline: Antwerp air cargo down 17.55pct in December '96.

text.p: Antwerp airport has seen a significant decline in freight tonnage in the month of December compared to the same month in 1995, an airport statement showed.
For the month of December 1996 the figures were as follows:
Movements for the month in 1996 have seen more than a 29 percent increase and passenger numbers too increased, up by 7.64 percent, on December 1995's figures.

However, freight volumes in December 1996 fell by 17.55 percent compared to the same month in 1995 when cargo volume had jumped by more than 410 percent above the comparable 1994 level. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
